data.name: JetX VR
data.detailed_description:
JetX features an arcade racing, epic battles in the arena and a rich variety of modes. Players can race with friends or compete against the bots to reach for the first place in the online leaderboard. Our game is an inviting challenge originally built for Virtual Reality, now also available for PC.
Crystal caves, otherworldly landscapes, space wastes in a sharp low-polygon aesthetics. Arm yourself, collect power-ups and go ahead to the victory!





  • Motion Is Life - Designed from scratch for VR to minimize motion-sickness, JetX features a powerful, unique flight system that gives you extensive control and impressive freedom.
  • Immersive VR - JetX is the fastest VR game ever made.
  • PC\VR Multiplayer - Race and battle against HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and PC players together, regardless of your platform of choice. VR support is optional.
  • Dynamic PvP battles - Carefully crafted combat mechanics and a variety of impactful power-ups always ensure no two fights feel the same.
  • Clever Bots - Never feel alone and even play offline: Designed to challenge and push you to your limits, our bots are not to be underestimated.
  • Multiple Weapons - Swap weapons on the fly or master your favorites; with multiple guns to choose from, you are sure to find a fit for your playstyle.
  • Game Modes - Pick from our expanding list of game types, including Race, Arena, Boss Battle, Energy Core and more to come!
  • Live Leaderboard - Veni, vidi, vici!





More levels, game modes, weapons, and new, awesome features are coming. Stay tuned!

Motion Sickness:


While many players will be able to jump right in without worry, we recommend sitting down for your first few games. Motion-sickness, should you experience it, dramatically decreases after one or two sessions. If you still have trouble, the game’s Safe Mode feature (accessible via the pause menu) will help alleviate your dizziness.

A Word From Singularity Lab:

This is one of our first complete game projects and we are extremely excited to hear any feedback you may have! The whole team at Singularity Lab has carefully crafted and polished each aspect of the game, in order to bring you the best possible experience.

We really hope you will like JetX! Thank you and see you in the game!

Team Singularity.

Available for arcade on SpringboardVR!

reviews.review:
JetX VR is a futuristic arcade racing and combat game that combines high-speed aerial maneuvering with competitive shooting in a colorful science-fiction setting. Developed by Singularity Lab and published by SA Industry, the game attempts to deliver an unconventional experience where players navigate three-dimensional environments, engage in aerial battles, and compete for superior performance. Its central attraction is the freedom to move through the air rather than remain confined to traditional racing tracks. This unusual combination gives the game a distinctive identity, although its ambitious mechanics also introduce challenges involving accessibility, repetition, and long-term enjoyment.

The flight mechanics are arguably the most interesting aspect of the experience. Players must develop an understanding of acceleration, positioning, and directional control while navigating environments filled with obstacles and competing opponents. Unlike conventional racing games, where movement generally follows a predetermined surface, JetX VR emphasizes spatial awareness and precise aerial navigation. Learning to maneuver effectively takes patience, particularly when maintaining speed through complicated environments. Once the controls become familiar, however, successful navigation can feel satisfying. The sensation of rapidly traveling through open spaces and narrowly avoiding obstacles creates the kind of excitement that makes arcade racing enjoyable.

Racing is only one part of the experience, as the game also incorporates arena combat and several alternative competitive activities. Players can participate in Race, Arena, Boss Battle, and Energy Core modes, each offering a different objective. Combat encounters involve weapon selection, power-ups, and rapid positioning adjustments as participants attempt to defeat opponents while remaining mobile. This combination encourages aggressive gameplay without completely abandoning tactical considerations. The ability to alternate between racing and combat provides welcome variety, although the fundamental reliance on aerial movement means the different modes can eventually begin to feel familiar.

The multiplayer component adds another layer of excitement by allowing players to compete against human opponents using compatible virtual reality equipment or conventional PC setups. This flexibility is valuable because it makes participation possible without requiring everyone to own a VR headset. Competitive encounters can be particularly entertaining when players have similar levels of experience, creating unpredictable battles and closely contested races. Computer-controlled opponents are also available, making solo practice possible and reducing dependence on multiplayer matchmaking. Nevertheless, artificial intelligence cannot entirely replace the excitement of human competition, and the quality of multiplayer entertainment depends heavily on finding active participants.

Visually, JetX VR adopts a vibrant low-polygon art style that prioritizes readability and atmosphere over realistic detail. Its environments include crystal-filled caves, unusual landscapes, and futuristic space-inspired locations that provide appealing backgrounds for high-speed competition. The colorful presentation complements the arcade-oriented gameplay, while relatively simple environmental geometry helps players identify obstacles during rapid movement. Although the graphics are not especially sophisticated, the visual direction suits the game's identity. The soundtrack and combat sound effects further reinforce its energetic science-fiction atmosphere, even if the audio presentation is unlikely to become its most memorable feature.

Virtual reality support significantly influences the overall design. The game aims to provide an immersive sense of aerial movement while incorporating comfort-oriented features intended to reduce motion sickness. A dedicated Safe Mode offers an alternative for players who find rapid virtual movement uncomfortable. Traditional non-VR gameplay is also supported, making the experience more accessible to players without specialized equipment. However, the unusual movement system can still require considerable adjustment, and individuals sensitive to VR locomotion may struggle with extended sessions. The game's emphasis on speed makes it exciting, but that same intensity can become physically demanding.

From a technical perspective, the game offers relatively manageable requirements for standard PC play, although virtual reality demands stronger hardware. Steam achievements and online leaderboards provide additional incentives for players interested in improving their skills. However, its greatest weakness is the possibility of limited replay value. While the different modes initially appear promising, their shared mechanics may eventually become repetitive. The demanding controls can also discourage newcomers, while the game's Mixed Steam user reception reflects a divided response to its execution. Its creative ideas are appealing, but the overall package lacks the refinement and sustained variety needed to satisfy a broader audience.

Steam Deck compatibility remains Unknown or Unverified, with no confirmed official Steam Deck compatibility rating. Although the game supports traditional non-VR gameplay, its Windows-oriented design means that successful operation through Proton cannot be guaranteed. Controller mapping, performance stability, and general usability on the handheld also remain uncertain. Players considering it specifically for Steam Deck should therefore exercise caution, particularly because its fast-paced flight controls may require adjustments to function comfortably on portable hardware.

Overall, JetX VR is an imaginative arcade experience that successfully combines futuristic racing, aerial combat, and virtual reality into an unusual competitive package. Its greatest strengths are the freedom of movement, energetic atmosphere, colorful environments, and flexibility between solo and multiplayer activities. Unfortunately, its steep learning curve, potentially repetitive gameplay, and dependence on an active multiplayer community prevent it from achieving its full potential. It is best suited to players who appreciate experimental arcade games and are willing to invest time in mastering unconventional movement systems. Despite its shortcomings, it offers enough personality and entertaining mechanics to make it worth considering for enthusiasts of high-speed science-fiction action.

A creative and occasionally thrilling fusion of aerial racing and combat that delivers distinctive gameplay, but limited depth and accessibility issues prevent it from becoming an outstanding experience.

Rating: 7/10
